title: Tracking the Unseen: An Occlusion-Robust Framework for Target Tracking Under Full and Long-Term Occlusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.17427v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time multi-object tracking systems remain highly vulnerable to full and long-term occlusion, where targets temporarily or completely disappear from the camera's field of view. Conventional trackers may terminate trajectories prematurely, resulting in identity loss and reduced situational awareness in applications such as defense and surveillance. This work proposes an occlusion-robust target tracking framework that maintains target identity and trajectory continuity through the integration of YOLOv11n object detection, Kalman Filter motion prediction, and occlusion-aware appearance-based re-identification. The framework consists of three stages: object detection, position estimation during occlusion, and identity recovery after target reappearance. Six Re-Identification (Re-ID) architectures were evaluated within the same tracking framework under identical conditions, with the Occlusion-Aware Mask Network (OAMN) achieving the best

translated_title: 追踪不可见目标：一种在全遮挡和长期遮挡下鲁棒的目标跟踪框架
translated_abstract: 实时多目标跟踪系统在全遮挡和长期遮挡情况下仍然高度脆弱，此时目标会暂时或完全从摄像机视野中消失。传统跟踪器可能会过早终止轨迹，导致身份丢失，并降低国防和监控等应用中的态势感知能力。本工作提出了一种抗遮挡的目标跟踪框架，通过集成YOLOv11n目标检测、卡尔曼滤波运动预测以及遮挡感知的基于外观的重识别技术，保持目标身份和轨迹的连续性。该框架由三个阶段组成：目标检测、遮挡期间的位置估计以及目标重新出现后的身份恢复。在相同条件下、同一跟踪框架内评估了六种重识别架构，其中遮挡感知掩码网络实现了最佳性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种抗遮挡的目标跟踪框架，通过融合YOLOv11n目标检测、卡尔曼滤波运动预测和遮挡感知重识别网络（OAMN），在全遮挡和长期遮挡情况下有效保持目标身份与轨迹连续性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an occlusion-robust target tracking framework that integrates YOLOv11n object detection, Kalman Filter motion prediction, and an Occlusion-Aware Mask Network (OAMN) for re-identification, maintaining target identity and trajectory continuity under full and long-term occlusion.
